company.name: Letswork
company.shortDescription: Letswork is a workspace membership platform that allows remote workers, freelancers, and teams to access flexible workspaces.
company.description:
Letswork is a Dubai-based startup founded in 2018 that provides an on-demand marketplace for workspaces. Through its mobile app and membership plans, users can work from a large network of partner locations including coworking spaces, cafés, and hotels without long-term office leases.

The platform connects professionals to hundreds of workspaces across multiple cities and countries, enabling them to book desks, meeting rooms, private offices, and creative studios whenever needed. It is designed to support remote work and digital nomads by offering flexible plans and instant check-in through the app.
